stage1_1_kick.description: Stage 1.1 — learn to kick (timesteps=25000). Robot spawns AT the ball (0.5 behind, on the ball-goal axis) facing the goal with ±15° jitter; ball near the centre line (y∈[-3,3]). `turn` and `approach_ball` are DISABLED so the only selectable action is firing `kick` from the at-ball state. The ±15° spread (≈ the goal's angular width from x∈[5,30]) makes the kick robust to small aim error and seeds the critic with 'better alignment → more reward', which the turn stages build on. From scratch (top-level load_model=null).

_pending_substages._how_to_advance: Run one sub-stage at a time. After a stage finishes, inspect the run, make any tweaks, then advance: (1) move the next stage's block from here into 'curriculum' (and remove the finished one), (2) set top-level 'load_model' to the finished stage's checkpoint, e.g. models/td3_jal_her/stage1_1_kick_complete.zip, (3) re-run the same launch command. num_robots stays 1 across all four, so TD3.load restores the expandable policy and the weights carry; the HER buffer is collected fresh each run.

stage1_2_turn_warmup.description: Stage 1.2 — turn warmup (timesteps=35000). Introduces `turn` at a modest ±60° spawn range with the wide ball-y (y∈[-15,15]); `approach_ball` stays disabled and the robot still spawns at the ball. Bridges the pure-kick skill to turning before the ±180° jump. goal_reward normalized 70→150 and invalid_action_penalty set to 0.5 to match the surrounding stages (the logged 70/none was an older-era value that would otherwise create a goal-scale jump mid-curriculum). alignment_weight kept at 0 — alignment shaping is introduced in 1.3. Set load_model to stage1_1_kick_complete.zip before running.

stage1_3_full_turn.description: Stage 1.3 — full ±180° turn (timesteps=150000). Robot spawns at the ball facing a random ±180° direction with wide ball-y (y∈[-15,15]); must turn to face the goal then kick. `approach_ball` re-enabled (harmless at spawn-at-ball), alignment_weight=2 provides a dense gradient toward facing the goal. This is the stage that produced the ~58% 'stage 1.6' model. Set load_model to stage1_2_turn_warmup_complete.zip before running.

stage1_4_approach_turn_kick.description: Stage 1.4 — approach + turn + kick (timesteps=200000). Robot now spawns at its default position AWAY from the ball with random ±180° orientation; the ball is placed randomly in the opponent half. Must use `approach_ball` to navigate to the ball, then turn and kick. approach_weight=2/clip=0.5 + near_ball_bonus=0.1 + step_bonus=-0.2 shape the navigation; alignment_weight=4 and kick_aim_bonus_weight=25 sharpen aim. This is the previous stage1_9 block, unchanged. Set load_model to stage1_3_full_turn_complete.zip before running. HER `future` relabeling supplies goal-conditioned virtual successes throughout each episode.

stage2_mixed_opponent.description: Reference only (NOT in curriculum, so not run by the trainer). Example stage demonstrating a mixed opponent: scripted goalie + frozen policy for other robots. Move into 'curriculum' and provide opp_frozen_checkpoint.zip to activate.

_curriculum_note: Stage 1 is retrained from scratch on the expandable backbone (use_expandable_backbone=true) as four sub-stages, run ONE AT A TIME so progress can be inspected between stages. Only the stage(s) inside 'curriculum' run; 1.2/1.3/1.4 are parked in '_pending_substages' until activated (see its _how_to_advance). Order: 1.1 learn-to-kick (turn off, ±15°) → 1.2 turn warmup (±60°) → 1.3 full ±180° turn → 1.4 approach+turn+kick (spawn away). num_robots=1 throughout, so the expandable policy weights carry across sub-stages via load_model. The gradual 90→120 angle ramp was dropped — it learned worse than jumping ±60°→±180°. Reward configs are the authentic values recovered from the original td3_jal_her run logs; stage 1.2's goal_reward was normalized 70→150 for cross-stage scale consistency.

model_params._action_noise_note: Global exploration sigma on the action vector. 0.3 keeps trained primitives mostly intact while leaving an exploration tail for under-trained action slots (e.g. approach_ball, unlocked in stage 1.4).
model_params._her_strategy_note: 'future' relabels stored transitions with diverse intermediate ball positions (essential for aim precision) rather than only the episode's terminal position. Requires the local patch to SB3 2.7.1 HerReplayBuffer._sample_goals that clamps the randint upper bound.
model_params._expandable_note: feature_dim/num_heads configure ExpandableJALFeatureExtractor (active because top-level use_expandable_backbone=true). include_goal feeds the HER desired_goal into the encoder's global branch so a later variable-target stage (e.g. passing) can fine-tune instead of needing an architecture change. Constant goal during stage 1, so harmless now.
